title: Solutions Pro Services Weekly Sync Notes - 2026-03-17
content:
Meeting: Solutions Eng + Pro Services Weekly Sync
Date: 2026-03-17 (weekly standup cadence)
Time: 10:00 - 10:45 PT
Location: Zoom / #solutions-pro-services (Slack)
Attendees: Priya Patel, Alex Chen, Daniel Kim, Samantha Ortiz, Jordan Lee, Maria Gomez, + guests from CS and Infra as noted

Agenda:
- Quick wins and blockers by customer
- Dedicated / Private deployment capacity updates
- Install/runbook gaps and handoff tasks
- Action items & owners

Summary (top-line):
- Overall progress is steady; three customer integrations are in pilot validation and one has a high-priority SSO blocker that needs infra + customer identity team alignment.
- Dedicated capacity request for two pilots approved (DEDICATED-119), infra to provision by EOD 2026-03-19.
- Runbook updates and a new post-install checklist created; link in linked_artifacts.

Customer updates:
1) ACME Retail (pilot)
- Status: Integration in validation phase.
- Progress since last week: Completed data ingestion schema mapping; embeddings batch job running against 3-week subset; initial quality checks show ~86% semantic match vs expected baseline.
- Blockers: SSO metadata mismatch with ACME IdP causing failed token exchange for some users. Customer to share IdP metadata and logs.
- Next steps: Priya to coordinate a 1:1 with ACME identity team tomorrow (2026-03-18). Daniel to prepare temporary fallback auth flow (short-lived API token) for demo on 2026-03-24.
- Open tickets: PROSERV-342 (see linked_artifacts).
- Owners: Priya (integration lead), Daniel (engineering), ACME contact: Jordan Myers

2) Nova Finance (pilot -> canary)
- Status: Canary rollout scheduled; model variant v2-quant deployed to dedicated pool.
- Progress: Canary traffic at 5% with monitoring hooks enabled in Console. Early latency within SLO (p95 ~230ms).
- Blockers: Minor mismatch in token-cost accounting across routes when using batching; affects billing estimate.
- Next steps: Alex to run reconciliation script and post results by 2026-03-18. If matched, escalate to finance for committed capacity pricing.
- Owners: Alex Chen (se), Maria Gomez (customer success)

3) Helix Health (proof-of-concept)
- Status: PoC data de-id pipeline in progress.
- Progress: On-prem connector validated for small batch; initial privacy checks passed.
- Blockers: Encryption at rest using customer KMS requires updated HSM bindings in the private control plane (infra work).
- Next steps: SRE/Infra ticket created, assigned to SRE team. Expected ETA 2026-03-22.
- Owners: Samantha Ortiz (solutions eng), Infra on-call: Daniel Kim

4) Orbit Logistics (pre-engagement)
- Status: Kickoff scheduled for 2026-03-20.
- Notes: Pre-kickoff checklist shared; customer requested capacity estimate for 300 requests/minute with 2k token average seq length. Alex to produce initial cost/latency estimate by 2026-03-19.

Platform / infra updates:
- Dedicated capacity: DEDICATED-119 approved; infra to provision two 8-GPU pools (region: us-west-2) by 2026-03-19. Work tracked in linked_artifacts.
- Smart routing: small patch to routing policy landed (PR #78) to prefer lower-cost variant when latency delta < 20ms. Monitoring flagged a 3% increase in tail latency for one scenario; team investigating.
- Telemetry: Added per-route token-level breakdown to Console for Nova Finance canary; visible in dashboards.

Runbook / docs updates:
- Updated Acme Integration Runbook with SSO troubleshooting section and fallback auth pattern. Confluence link in linked_artifacts.
- New post-install checklist created (installer validation, KMS setup, tracing hooks). Team to review and sign off; comments due 2026-03-19.

Risks / Blockers (high priority):
- ACME SSO mismatch (high) — blocks demo if not resolved by 2026-03-23. Action: Priya to escalate to ACME IdP team; Daniel to prepare fallback.
- HSM/KMS bindings for Helix Health (medium) — infra ETA 2026-03-22. Must be prioritized for on-prem PoCs.

Action Items (owners & deadlines):
- Priya: Schedule ACME IdP sync and escalate if no metadata provided by EOD 2026-03-18.
- Daniel: Implement temp fallback auth flow for ACME demo (due 2026-03-19).
- Alex: Run billing reconciliation for Nova Finance batching discrepancy (due 2026-03-18).
- Maria: Prepare customer-facing canary summary for Nova Finance (due 2026-03-19).
- Samantha: Coordinate with Infra on HSM binding ticket and confirm ETA (due 2026-03-18).
- Jordan: Prepare kickoff materials for Orbit Logistics and confirm data schema request (due 2026-03-19).

Notes / Misc:
- Reminder: Please reference Jira ticket keys in all PRs and Confluence updates.
- Next sync: 2026-03-24 same time. If high-priority issues surface, ad-hoc sync will be scheduled.

Meeting adjourned at 10:45 PT.

Raw meeting transcript & recordings: Zoom link posted to #solutions-pro-services.
